subject: general
question: Kumar Gandharva, a renowned vocalist, is known for which of the following genres of music?
solution:
The correct answer is **__H__****__industani classical__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Kumar Gandharva:**

__
 
• He was born in** Belgaum, Karnataka in 1924.**
 
• He does** not belong to any traditional Gharana system.**
 
• He was awarded by:
 
 
• **​****Padma Bhushan** in 1977
 
• **Padma Vibhushan** in 1990
 
 
 
• Prominent ragas articulated by him are, **Beehad Bairav, Ahimohini, Madhsuraja, and Sanjaari.**

**​Hindustani Classical:**

 
• It is influenced by the **Persian and Mughal empires** in the **northern part** of the country.
 
• The main vocal forms are **Dhrupad, Khyal, Thumri, Tarana, Ghazal, and Dadra.**
 
• **Based on the Gharana style: **Lucknow, Jaipur, Kairana, Agra, etc.
 
• Greater emphasis on the moral construct of song i.e. **Nadi and Samvadi swars.**
 
• In this style, emotions are not enhanced by ornamentation.
 
• **Associated instruments: Tabla, Santoor, Sitar, Sarangi, etc.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****
